title: We Kept Building!
excerpt: After showcasing Node 1 at EngEx 2025, we didn't stop working on it. We went back to the hardware and started refining the physical product itself.

title: We Refined it!
excerpt: One of the things we learned from building Node 1 is that a functional prototype and a finished-looking piece of hardware are two very different things.

title: Built to Connect!
excerpt: Building connected hardware means thinking beyond the physical device. Node 1 wasn't designed to exist on its own. Alongside the hardware, we developed a web-based interface to interact with the device and make its data accessible through a digital layer.

title: Designed from Scratch!
excerpt: One of the biggest steps in taking Node 1 from an experimental prototype toward a more refined hardware build was designing a custom PCB.
